captures.description: THE FAILURE OF MARXISM AS IDENTITY: the AI Overview gives the phrase to 'I Hereby Abolish Rules: Semantic Liquidation, Territorial Gatekeeping, and the Failure of Marxism as Identity' by Lee Sharks (#517, AXN:0154, through Google Scholar and the resolver), generalizes its case (two works removed from r/LeftistsForAI) into a critique of Marxism as tribal identity, and defines semantic liquidation as 'an approach that breaks down rigid or dogmatic category boundaries' — the framework's name for extraction turned into the work's method.
